title: SnakeTranslate: Weakly Supervised Policy Learning from Offline Parallel Text for Simultaneous Translation
abstract: arXiv:2611.28055v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Adaptive simultaneous translation requires reliable prefix translation and timely READ/WRITE decisions, but ordinary parallel corpora provide no action annotations. We present SnakeTranslate, which adapts loss-derived alignment to sampled causal histories for jointly learning both capabilities. The framework supports supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on parallel text and on-policy distillation (OPD) with reverse Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence on student-generated translations. At inference, source and target tokens form one append-only interleaved history, enabling incremental decoding with cache reuse. On FLEURS, NTREX128, and WMT24++, our 4B model improves quality--latency trade-offs over streaming policies applied to the same offline-tuned backbone, with further gains from OPD. It also compares favorably with larger translation models at low and moderate latency, while higher-latency quality gaps remain on WMT24++.

translated_title: SnakeTranslate：基于离线平行文本的同声传译弱监督策略学习
translated_abstract: 自适应同声传译需要可靠的前缀翻译能力和及时的READ/WRITE（读/写）决策，但普通的平行语料库并不提供动作标注。我们提出了SnakeTranslate，它将损失推导的对齐适配到采样的因果历史中，从而联合学习这两种能力。该框架支持在平行文本上进行监督微调（SFT），以及在模型自身生成的译文上进行采用反向Kullback–Leibler（KL）散度的同策略蒸馏（OPD）。在推理阶段，源语言与目标语言的词元构成一个仅追加的交错历史，从而实现支持缓存复用的增量解码。在FLEURS、NTREX128和WMT24++数据集上，我们的4B模型相比应用于同一离线微调骨干模型的流式策略，改善了质量-延迟权衡，且OPD带来了进一步提升。该模型在低延迟和中延迟条件下与更大的翻译模型相比表现出色，但在较高延迟下，WMT24++上仍存在质量差距。
tldr: SnakeTranslate通过对齐适配的弱监督方法，仅利用普通平行文本即可联合训练同声传译的前缀翻译能力与READ/WRITE决策策略，结合SFT与反向KL散度同策略蒸馏以及支持缓存复用的增量解码，使4B模型在多个基准上实现了优于流式策略的质量-延迟权衡。
